page.notes: The first word "bus" is a fragment; the first letter is partly hidden in the gutter and may be a larger initial, so the reading "bus" is less certain. "Samaritice" has a grave accent over the final e in print, shown here without it; the italic line may be slightly unclear. The 1 in the page number looks like a dotted i ("116"). Ligatures and spellings such as "qvi", "qvia", "qvod" are rendered with u as "qui", "quia", "quod" per the convention, but the printed forms use v in "qvi", "qvia", "qvod" and "reliqvo". The "Rab-" at the foot is a catchword, not part of the text.
